title: Friend File Drop
summary: Send private files between mixed devices and get a clear receipt.
smallest_useful_product: A browser-based WebRTC transfer room with a six-word code, explicit file manifest and hash, resumable same-LAN fallback, and a sender/receiver completion receipt.
constraints: Use an opt-in relay only when direct WebRTC fails; disclose relay metadata; scan neither content nor contacts; rate-limit abuse.
